drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 61-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.66, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 302, sodium 139, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 71-76, heart_rate 76-81, map 88-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 118-123, spo2 95-96, temp 37-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.04, hemoglobin 13, platelets 303, sodium 140, wbc 5.6; vitals dbp 70-76, heart_rate 77-81, map 87-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 122-126, spo2 95-97, temp 37-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 61-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
